description: This file contains unit tests for the DhcpPacFileFetcherWin class and related components, testing DHCP PAC file fetching logic on Windows, including various scenarios like cancellation, timeouts, and reuse.

classes.name: RealFetchTester
classes.description: Helper class to perform DHCP PAC file fetch tests, including cancellation and deferred cancellation scenarios.

classes.name: DummyDhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher
classes.description: Mock implementation of DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher for testing, simulating PAC script fetches with configurable delays and results.

classes.name: MockDhcpPacFileFetcherWin
classes.description: Mock subclass of DhcpPacFileFetcherWin to simulate DHCP adapter fetchers and adapter queries for testing.

classes.name: FetcherClient
classes.description: Test client to run DHCP PAC fetch operations, handle completion, and manage fetcher state for various test scenarios.

methods.name: RunTest
methods.description: Initiates a fetch operation and handles completion or cancellation.

methods.name: RunTestWithCancel
methods.description: Performs a fetch operation and cancels immediately.

methods.name: RunTestWithDeferredCancel
methods.description: Performs a fetch operation with a delayed cancel to test deferred cancellation handling.

methods.name: FinishTestAllowCleanup
methods.description: Allows worker threads to finish, with a sleep delay.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures dummy fetcher with specific result, script, and delay.
